plan.objective: Establish a decisive flying clock while controlling the visible oversized trample threat; preserve a meaningful blocker and any useful interaction.
plan.guidance: Use sequencing/resource policy: the known 5 mana cannot cast Smaug ({2}{R}{R}) and still retain meaningful interaction, but Kellan already supplies double-strike pressure and Sanctuary is an available 3/3 vigilant blocker. Do not spend resources animating a land already animated. Opponent is at 6; Kellan's unblocked double strike is lethal. Explorer is tapped? Forecast shows it untapped but summoning sick; it can block. Attack with Kellan only if it is not blocked by Explorer; preserve Sanctuary to block the 4/6 trampler. No known instant or removal in hand. Reassess after draw and combat; unknown draws are not assumed.

steps.label: Attack with Kellan
steps.purpose: Pressure lethal; if blocked, Sanctuary remains back to defend against Explorer.

phases.goal: Exploit Kellan's double strike for lethal if unblocked; preserve defense if blocked.
phases.guidance: Opponent is at 6 and Kellan deals 3 twice if it connects, lethal. Explorer can block Kellan, so do not treat lethal as guaranteed. If blocked, Sanctuary remains available for the 4/6 trample return attack.

phases.goal: Develop while retaining Sanctuary as a blocker.
phases.guidance: Cast Emberheart Challenger for {1}{R} if mana permits; otherwise cast Hired Claw for {R}. Do not cast Smaug if doing so requires using Sanctuary as a mana source needed to preserve the block. No land is in hand. Keep remaining sources available; there is no burn in hand.

phases.goal: Use Sanctuary to prevent lethal or reduce trample damage.
phases.guidance: If Explorer attacks, block with the 3/3 vigilant Sanctuary when it prevents lethal or substantially reduces damage. Explorer is 4/6 with trample: Sanctuary absorbs 3, leaving 1 trample damage, and Sanctuary dies. Kellan cannot block if tapped attacking. Finish blocks.

phases.goal: Reassess actual threats and preserve available defense.
phases.guidance: No removal spell is known in hand. If new visible threats or a lethal attack changes the exchange, prioritize survival; otherwise keep Sanctuary available to block Explorer.

holds.purpose: Keep animated Sanctuary untapped to block Explorer's trampling attack.
